priceQuality.normalization: canonical latest view: one canonical card, accepted condition/printing selected by price_selection_reason

coverage.cohort: ALL priced cards in exact-scarcity sets

methodology.cv_centering: fit on training sets only; applied unchanged to held-out set
methodology.inference: set fixed effects + set-cluster robust SE; two-way set/subject SE when subject key exists
methodology.selection_policy: report all registered components; do not tune or select V6 here
methodology.weight_transfer_policy: price-fit coefficients must never be copied into Collector Appeal or RIP weights

matchedCards.policy: same set/rarity/slot/promo/secret/mechanic; scarcity delta <=0.05; Appeal delta >=10
